ownership_inventory.owner: The declaring runtime subsystem owns each field; lifecycle aliases share one absolute slot only in mutually exclusive phases
The declaring module owns software addresses; the named CoCo/GIME/PIA device owns hardware-register aliases
The bootstrap owns bytes through copy and validation; the destination module owns them after handoff
The named gameplay, presentation, or framebuffer subsystem owns the authoritative record for its documented lifetime
The runtime memory atlas assigns one phase-qualified owner to every allocated physical page interval
The active executive PAR mapping and scoped PAR5 borrower own each virtual range
The sparse-layout manifest and bootstrap own every CPU-readable GMC source interval
Each physical framebuffer owns pixels and its A/B-local actor history; direct-page protocol state owns publication only
The 6809 system stack exclusively owns $1e00-$1fff after copied-module publication
The exporting module owns each entry; build-generated includes bind consumers to current map addresses
Each authored data label belongs to its declaring module; generated table fields belong to their producing generator schema

root.inputs: Entry-specific machine state and the shared direct-page protocol named by the routine purpose
root.outputs: Control transfers or status values defined by the routine purpose
root.clobbers: A, B, D, X, Y, U, and condition codes unless the caller-facing entry contract states otherwise
root.reads: Always-mapped direct-page protocol state plus the module-owned state required by the selected operation
root.writes: Module-owned state and mapped hardware registers required to establish or dispatch the operation
root.side_effects: May change mapping, interrupt, rendering, or lifecycle ownership as stated by the routine purpose
root.invariants: The stack remains balanced and every temporary PAR mapping is restored or deliberately handed off before return

state.inputs: Current authoritative gameplay or presentation state; register arguments are named by the routine label and immediate caller
state.outputs: Updated authoritative state and condition codes used by the immediate caller
state.clobbers: A, B, D, X, Y, U, and condition codes unless a narrower source-local header is present
state.reads: Owned direct-page and page-$34 state needed for the operation
state.writes: Only the owned state fields and render intents required by the operation
state.side_effects: May enqueue rendering work but does not publish FRONT
state.invariants: Authoritative state changes precede their render intents; framebuffer publication remains IRQ-owned

render.inputs: Current render intent, selected actor or tile state, and a valid BACK or staging destination
render.outputs: Updated destination pixels and any owner-local history required by later restoration
render.clobbers: A, B, D, X, Y, U, and condition codes unless a narrower source-local header is present
render.reads: Authoritative gameplay state, immutable art streams, and current owner-local background metadata
render.writes: BACK or staging pixels, render scratch, and owner-local save-under or damage metadata
render.side_effects: Changes a non-visible composition surface or its metadata
render.invariants: The routine never selects the visible FRONT surface; temporary PAR5 mappings expire or restore before return

framebuffer.inputs: ACTIVE/PENDING state, BACK identity, owner metadata, and the current worklist
framebuffer.outputs: A prepared, captured, finished, or published framebuffer transaction as named by the routine
framebuffer.clobbers: A, B, D, X, Y, U, and condition codes unless the fixed entry contract narrows them
framebuffer.reads: Always-mapped framebuffer protocol bytes and owner-local metadata
framebuffer.writes: Framebuffer protocol bytes, BACK pixels, owner-local metadata, and GIME display offset only at IRQ publication
framebuffer.side_effects: Advances one bounded phase of the persistent A/B transaction
framebuffer.invariants: Foreground code may arm PENDING but only Vbord IRQ publishes FRONT; mapping-sensitive pointers do not outlive PAR changes

movement.inputs: Current actor coordinates, direction, maze topology, gate state, and collision state
movement.outputs: A legality result, selected direction, contact result, or updated actor state
movement.clobbers: A, B, D, X, Y, U, and condition codes unless a narrower source-local header is present
movement.reads: Authoritative actor records, maze and gate tables, and movement scratch
movement.writes: Owned actor state, collision flags, and render intents required by the movement result
movement.side_effects: May change authoritative gameplay state and queue later composition
movement.invariants: Movement remains on legal semantic cells and does not write framebuffer pixels directly

copy.inputs: Source and destination identities, bounded count or stream metadata, and any required mapped page
copy.outputs: Copied, decoded, merged, cached, or addressed data plus caller-visible pointer progress
copy.clobbers: A, B, D, X, Y, U, and condition codes unless a narrower source-local header is present
copy.reads: The declared source stream, table, framebuffer rows, or metadata record
copy.writes: Only the declared bounded destination record, cache, row range, or scratch fields
copy.side_effects: May temporarily map PAR5 while moving or decoding data
copy.invariants: Counts and destination bounds are honored; temporary mappings are restored before returning

presentation.inputs: Presentation state, interval timer, input edges, current map, and the selected auxiliary profile
presentation.outputs: Updated presentation state and the dispatcher retain/release status when applicable
presentation.clobbers: A, B, D, X, Y, U, and condition codes unless a narrower source-local header is present
presentation.reads: Presentation direct-page state, cold payloads, authored map streams, and input state
presentation.writes: Presentation state, mapped BACK pixels, and presentation-owned persistent metadata
presentation.side_effects: May retain the foreground interval or produce a complete presentation surface
presentation.invariants: Gameplay mutation begins only after the dispatcher releases the interval; FRONT publication remains IRQ-owned

input.inputs: PIA input state, prior sampled state, and axis or key selection
input.outputs: Normalized input state, edge bits, or axis sample
input.clobbers: A, B, D, X, Y, U, and condition codes unless a narrower source-local header is present
input.reads: PIA registers and prior input samples
input.writes: Owned input state and temporary PIA scan selection
input.side_effects: Temporarily drives keyboard or joystick scan hardware
input.invariants: PIA control and drive state are restored to the runtime convention before return

boot.inputs: The declared cartridge bank, staged payload, destination identity, and bootstrap mapping state
boot.outputs: Installed runtime bytes or a non-returning transfer to the next boot phase
boot.clobbers: All CPU registers and condition codes
boot.reads: Cartridge-staged payloads, generated size symbols, and bootstrap tables
boot.writes: Declared RAM destinations, PAR registers, boot scratch, and decompressed surfaces
boot.side_effects: Changes MMU mappings and copies or synthesizes executable/data payloads
boot.invariants: Authored, staged, and destination byte identities remain distinct and every transfer obeys its generated size bound
